items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Existing AI benchmarks focus on simple tasks, but InfraDev tests complex infrastructure changes across multiple GPUs. MLE-World is a model that predicts outcomes of machine learning experiments without actually running them. Current diabetes risk prediction models focus more on accuracy than reliability. Researchers created a new framework using patient data and AI to better predict blood sugar changes. Microsoft's stock increased by 4% after the company reported higher-than-expected earnings.
